solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Feeble old man, by Thursday at home

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
per means by, as in 'per post'
in means at home, as in 'staying in'

explanation.surface: An elderly father, frail, waiting at home for Thursday to come round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Feeble' looks like a description of the old man, but it is the definition on its own.
explanation.definitionFit: A flimsy excuse or argument is described as having almost no substance, like a sheet of paper.

clue.text: Big felines getting in step I am thinking

indicators.note: getting in says the hesitation sound goes inside the step word

parts.note: pas is a step in ballet
um is the sound someone makes while thinking

explanation.surface: A dancer thinks about big cats while getting into step.
explanation.definitionFit: Cougars, the large wild cats of the Americas, are big felines.

clue.text: Was bothered by volume having increasingly narrow endpiece

parts.note: a pint is a volume of liquid
ailed means was troubled

explanation.surface: Someone was troubled by a volume with a tapering final section.
explanation.definitionFit: Some ducks have pointed, tapering tails, so this describes a tail that narrows towards its tip.

clue.text: A sweet accompaniment with dance, almost complete

indicators.note: almost means the dance is cut short of its final letter

parts.note: the rumba is a Cuban dance
utter means complete, as in 'utter nonsense'

explanation.surface: A sweet accompanies a dance that is almost finished.
explanation.walkthrough: RUMBA loses its last letter to give RUMB. This butter laced with rum is served in Britain with Christmas pudding.
explanation.definitionFit: This rich spread of butter, sugar and rum is a sweet sauce served alongside desserts.

clue.text: Popular verse about teacher got top press billing

parts.note: a hit is a popular success
the head is a head teacher, a school's principal
lines are verse

explanation.surface: A popular poem about a teacher made the front page.
explanation.walkthrough: 'verse about teacher' reads as lines about the head: THE HEAD then LINES.
explanation.definitionFit: To make the front-page news is to receive top billing in the newspapers.

clue.text: Count on supervised girl being of high intellect?

parts.note: a count is a noble
minded means looked after or supervised
Ness is a rare Scottish forename

explanation.surface: A count relies on a girl he supervised who proves to be highly intelligent.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark admits the stretch: 'high intellect' is read as lofty thinking, i.e. moral elevation.
explanation.definitionFit: Having lofty principles is to be of an elevated mind, so of high mental character.

clue.text: Indian title of book one's holding back

indicators.note: back tells the solver to read the assembled letters from right to left

parts.note: read as 'one has', meaning one holds: I for one plus HAS

explanation.surface: An Indian honorific is taken from a book that someone is withholding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns round the string B + I + HAS, giving the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a respectful form of address used in colonial India for a European man or a man of rank.

clue.text: State prosecutor getting tabloid coverage

indicators.note: getting here means receiving something around oneself, the first half of the wrapping signal
getting tabloid coverage means the prosecutor is wrapped in the paper's name

parts.note: The Sun is a British tabloid newspaper
a DA is a district attorney, an American prosecutor

explanation.surface: A state prosecutor gets coverage in the tabloid press.
explanation.walkthrough: The Sun is a British tabloid newspaper.
explanation.definitionFit: This African nation is a sovereign state.

clue.text: Shrink with a vocation causing mayhem

indicators.note: shrink means the phrase is reduced to a run of its inner letters

explanation.surface: A psychiatrist with a calling causes chaos.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shrink' looks like a psychiatrist, but it signals that the letters are taken from inside WITH A VOCATION.
explanation.definitionFit: Widespread devastation or chaos is mayhem.

clue.text: Tinned meat from cow — and grouse

parts.note: to cow someone is to bully them
to beef is to grouse or complain

explanation.surface: Canned meat from a cow, and a game bird too.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cow' and 'grouse' look like animals but are verbs: intimidate and complain.
explanation.definitionFit: Corned beef in tins, a staple army ration, goes by this name.

clue.text: Football team with mass appeal deliver

parts.note: Man U is the familiar short name of Manchester United
m is the symbol for mass in physics
it means sex appeal, as in 'she has it'

explanation.surface: A football club with wide popularity delivers on the pitch.
explanation.walkthrough: Man U is Manchester United, an English football club.
explanation.definitionFit: To free a slave is to release them from bondage, a formal sense of deliver.

clue.text: Dog, as it happens, getting back on couch

parts.note: a couch can be a bed

indicators.note: getting back says the word for 'as it happens' is turned round

parts.note: a live broadcast is one shown as it happens

explanation.surface: A dog climbs back onto the couch while the television shows events live.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dog' reads as the animal on the couch, but it is a verb meaning to plague; 'getting back' turns the live word round.
explanation.definitionFit: To dog someone is to plague or harass them persistently, as troubles torment a person.

clue.text: American hosts cool, reclining in mess as usual

indicators.note: reclining in an across clue means lying back, so the letters run backwards
hosts means the American letters hold the cool word inside

parts.note: US is short for United States, so American
to fan something is to cool it

explanation.surface: An American, lying back and cooling off, entertains guests amid the usual chaos.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hosts' puts the cool word inside, giving UFANS, and 'reclining' reads that backwards; the definition is a whole phrase, glossing the acronym.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a military acronym for 'situation normal, all fouled up': a muddle that is entirely typical.

clue.text: Alternative cure handy for major complaint

indicators.note: an alternative version of the letters is a fresh arrangement of them

explanation.surface: Alternative medicine offers a convenient cure for a serious illness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Alternative' suggests alternative medicine, but it is the anagram signal on CURE HANDY.
explanation.definitionFit: A loud public outcry or protest is a big complaint; historically it was the shout raised to chase a criminal.

clue.text: … but if south-facing, becoming much brighter

definitions.text: … but if south-facing, becoming much brighter

parts.words: … but if south-facing, becoming much brighter
parts.note: put S, for south, at the front of the word for dark and it becomes the word for bathed in sunshine

explanation.surface: A dim room would be far lighter if it faced south.
explanation.walkthrough: S (south) in front 'facing' the answer makes SUNLIT; the word for dark is the one that would become brighter.
explanation.definitionFit: Something without lighting is dark, which is the condition that facing the sun would change.

clue.text: Superior fruitcake boy's kept to himself?

parts.note: U means upper class, superior
a fruitcake or nutter is an eccentric person
Ed is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A posh eccentric lad keeps himself to himself.
explanation.definitionFit: Words never spoken aloud are, in effect, kept private by the speaker.

clue.text: Hard toenails troubled one in the shower

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

indicators.note: troubled toenails are disturbed ones, so their letters are stirred up

explanation.surface: Someone's hard, painful toenails bother them while they shower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'troubled' scrambles the toenails into AILSTONE. 'Shower' means a fall of rain or hail, not a bathroom.
explanation.definitionFit: A single frozen pellet falling from the sky is one item in a shower of hail.

clue.text: Miss warning put out on air

parts.note: a sign can be a warning

indicators.note: put out means the words on air are disturbed into a new order

explanation.surface: A warning is broadcast on the radio.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put out on air' poses as broadcasting, but 'put out' scrambles ON AIR into ORINA.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the Italian equivalent of Miss, a title for an unmarried woman.

clue.text: Runner who must find way round rotten tree in race, gutted

parts.note: O is round in shape

indicators.note: rotten means the letters are decayed into a different arrangement
gutted means the inside of race is removed, leaving its outer letters

explanation.surface: A runner must work around a rotten tree on the race route.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gutted' leaves RE from the race word; 'rotten' then scrambles TREE IN RE into RIENTEER. 'round' is a letter, not part of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Competitors in this sport navigate cross-country with a map and compass, so they must find their way.

clue.text: Displaying craft gift not enough?

explanation.surface: Someone shows off their handicraft, though the present seems a little stingy.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading splits the answer into UNDER (not enough) and HAND (give).
explanation.definitionFit: A sly, deceitful dealing shows cunning; a gift handed over short is given under.

clue.text: Suffering: force for good later in composer

indicators.note: force for good means the force letter takes the place of the good letter
later in says the swap happens at the second of the two matching letters in the composer's name

parts.note: Edvard Grieg was a Norwegian composer
F is the symbol for force in physics

explanation.surface: A composer's anguish is transformed into a force for good later in life.
explanation.walkthrough: GRIEG has two Gs; 'later' picks the final one to become F.
explanation.definitionFit: Deep sorrow, especially after a loss, is a form of mental suffering.

clue.text: A number of volunteers, note, commanded army?

parts.note: ten is a number
the TA, Territorial Army, is Britain's volunteer reserve force
C is a musical note
led means commanded, as troops are led

explanation.surface: Some volunteers note that they commanded an army.
explanation.walkthrough: 'army' is read as 'having arms', which is what an octopus is; the TA is the Territorial Army, a British reserve force.
explanation.definitionFit: A creature with many long flexible limbs might jokingly be called armed or arm-y.

clue.text: Garment frequently dropping off, could one say?

definitions.text: frequently dropping off, could one say?
definitions.meaning: jocularly, prone to naps, from nap plus the -y ending

explanation.surface: An item of clothing keeps falling off.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading is a made-up word: someone who naps often might be called this.
explanation.definitionFit: Babies wear this item, the British word for a diaper; a dozy person who keeps nodding off is jokingly the same.

clue.text: A note in which a managing director's put up someone for promotion

indicators.note: in which means the following pieces go inside the A and note pair
put up in a down clue means written upwards, so reversed

explanation.surface: A memo in which a managing director proposes someone for promotion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put up' turns A MD into DMA, which goes between A and N.
explanation.definitionFit: Advertising people work in promotion, selling products to the public.

clue.text: Mature person, hiding the grey, to be honest

indicators.note: hiding means the grey abbreviation is kept out of sight, so removed

parts.note: an adult is a mature person
gr is an abbreviation of grey

explanation.surface: An older person dyes their grey hair but should come clean about it.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove GR from GROWNUP to leave the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To confess or admit something is to be honest about it.

clue.text: Goes on green after driving off?

definitions.text: Goes on green after driving off?

parts.words: Goes on green after driving off?
parts.note: on a golf course, after hitting the tee shot the player's strokes on the green are taps towards the hole

explanation.surface: A motorist pulls away when the light turns green.
explanation.walkthrough: 'green' and 'driving' suggest traffic lights, but this is golf: a drive from the tee, then strokes on the putting green.
explanation.definitionFit: Gentle golf strokes played on the green towards the hole come after the long drive.

clue.text: Agent who gets back from sultanate with traveller

parts.note: a rep is a travelling salesperson
Oman is a sultanate in Arabia

explanation.surface: A secret agent returns home from an Arab sultanate with a fellow traveller.
explanation.definitionFit: A repossession man reclaims goods when the buyer misses payments, so his job is retrieving property.

clue.text: Demanding one stops person having sex change?

indicators.note: stops means the letter for one plugs a gap in the other piece

parts.note: someone who has changed sex from male could be called an ex-gent
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A demanding individual stands in the way of someone transitioning.
explanation.walkthrough: A person who has changed sex from male is jokily a former gentleman; 'stops' plugs that gap with one.
explanation.definitionFit: Something urgent and pressing, requiring much effort, is demanding.

clue.text: Member greatly respected long after the event?

indicators.note: after means the word for long comes behind the event word

parts.note: a do is a party or social event
to yen is to long for something

explanation.surface: A distinguished member is remembered long after the occasion is over.
explanation.definitionFit: The most senior and respected member of a group or profession is its senior figure.

clue.text: Freshness augmented by a brother's flavouring

parts.note: sass is cheek or impudence, as is freshness
Fra is the title of an Italian friar, a brother, plus 's

explanation.surface: A monk's cheekiness is increased by a little added zest.
explanation.definitionFit: The bark of this North American tree is used to flavour drinks such as root beer.
